verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Kino publishes an llms.txt at https://kino.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200), so a user can point an agent at it. However, the captured content is only a title and a one-line summary, and no evidence shows that the file indexes the docs or that dedicated agent-oriented documentation exists. The MCP-server material belongs to a different story and is not credited here. Missing for 10: evidence of substantive llms.txt content (doc links or sections), dedicated agent-oriented docs such as llms-full.txt or markdown docs, and independent corroboration that agents use it effectively.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Where your team and agents make great videos. Your footage, your edit and your review notes live in one place.
